e.en: My grandmother taught me to {knit} a simple scarf.
e.zh: 我奶奶教我编织一条简单的围巾。

e.en: The team is a tightly-{knit} group of close friends.
e.zh: 这支队伍是一群关系紧密的好朋友。

knits.t:
v. 编织（knit 第三人称单数）
n. 针织衫

e.en: She {knits} sweaters for charity every winter.
e.zh: 她每年冬天都为慈善机构编织毛衣。

e.en: The store sells cozy wool {knits} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 那家店在节日期间出售温暖的羊毛针织衫。

knitted.t:
adj. 针织的
v. 编织（过去式）

e.en: She wore a {knitted} hat to keep warm on the hike.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶针织帽在徒步中保暖。

e.en: My mom {knitted} matching mittens for all the cousins.
e.zh: 我妈妈为所有表兄弟姐妹编织了配套的连指手套。

e.en: My aunt is a skilled {knitter} who sells her sweaters online.
e.zh: 我阿姨是一位熟练的编织者，她在网上卖自己的毛衣。

e.en: Every avid {knitter} dreams of designing their own pattern.
e.zh: 每位热衷的编织者都梦想着设计自己的图案。

e.en: She finds {knitting} relaxing after a long workday.
e.zh: 漫长的工作日后，她觉得编织能让人放松。

e.en: My grandma joined a local {knitting} club at the library.
e.zh: 我奶奶加入了图书馆里的一个本地编织俱乐部。

e.en: This brand specializes in luxury cashmere {knitwear} for winter.
e.zh: 这个品牌专门生产冬季的奢华羊绒针织品。

e.en: The store discounted all {knitwear} at the end of the season.
e.zh: 那家店在季末把所有针织衫都打了折。

e.en: Keep sharp {knives} out of reach of small children.
e.zh: 把锋利的刀具放在小孩拿不到的地方。

e.en: The chef sharpens his {knives} before every dinner service.
e.zh: 厨师在每次晚餐服务前都会磨好他的刀。

e.en: He typed "i {kno} right?" in the casual group chat.
e.zh: 他在那个轻松的群聊里打了"我懂吧"的拼写省略形式。

e.en: The text "{kno} what I mean?" is internet slang for know.
e.zh: "{kno} what I mean?"是网络用语，是know的简写。

e.en: Turn the volume {knob} down before plugging in the headphones.
e.zh: 在插入耳机前先把音量旋钮调低。

e.en: The old door {knob} kept falling off whenever I opened it.
e.zh: 那个旧门把手每次开门时都会掉下来。

knobbly.t: adj. 多节瘤的；凹凸不平的

e.en: The old tree had {knobbly} roots sticking out of the ground.
e.zh: 那棵老树有许多多节的树根从地面伸出。

e.en: She rubbed her {knobbly} knees after the long bike ride.
e.zh: 长途骑行后，她揉着自己骨节突出的膝盖。

knobby.t: adj. 多节瘤的；疙疙瘩瘩的

e.en: His {knobby} fingers struggled to button the small shirt.
e.zh: 他骨节粗大的手指很难扣上那件小衬衫的纽扣。

e.en: The mountain bike has {knobby} tires for rough trails.
e.zh: 那辆山地车装着用于崎岖路面的颗粒胎。

knock.t:
v. 敲；撞
n. 敲击声

e.en: Please {knock} before entering my room.
e.zh: 进我房间前请先敲门。

e.en: Don't {knock} the new feature until you've tried it.
e.zh: 在尝试之前不要批评这个新功能。

e.en: The kids enjoyed a {knockabout} comedy show at the fair.
e.zh: 孩子们在游园会上看了一场闹剧风格的喜剧表演。

e.en: He wore old {knockabout} clothes for working in the garden.
e.zh: 他穿着耐脏耐磨的旧衣服在花园里干活。

knockdown.t:
n. 击倒
adj. 极低的（价格）

e.en: The furniture is sold at {knockdown} prices this weekend.
e.zh: 这周末家具以超低价出售。

e.en: He delivered a {knockdown} blow in the second round.
e.zh: 他在第二回合击出了一记将对手击倒的重拳。

knocked.t: v. 敲；撞（knock 的过去式）

e.en: Someone {knocked} on the door while I was cooking.
e.zh: 我在做饭时有人敲门。

e.en: The strong wind {knocked} a tree onto the road.
e.zh: 大风把一棵树吹倒在路上。

e.en: The old mansion had a brass lion {knocker} on the door.
e.zh: 那座老宅的门上有一只黄铜狮子门环。

e.en: She lifted the heavy door {knocker} and tapped twice.
e.zh: 她抬起沉重的门环，敲了两下。

knocking.t:
n. 敲击声
v. 敲打（进行时）

e.en: I heard someone {knocking} loudly at the back door.
e.zh: 我听到有人在后门大声敲门。

e.en: The engine started {knocking} after we used cheap fuel.
e.zh: 用了便宜的汽油后，发动机开始发出爆震声。

e.en: That handbag is a cheap {knockoff} of the designer brand.
e.zh: 那个手提包是名牌的廉价仿冒品。

e.en: Tourists often buy {knockoff} watches at the night market.
e.zh: 游客经常在夜市买仿冒手表。

knockout.t:
n. 击倒；淘汰赛
adj. 极出色的

e.en: The boxer won the match by {knockout} in round three.
e.zh: 拳击手在第三回合以击倒对手赢得比赛。

e.en: Her new dress is an absolute {knockout} at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上穿的新裙子真是惊艳全场。

knocks.t: v. 敲（knock 第三人称单数）

e.en: Life {knocks} you down sometimes, but you must keep going.
e.zh: 生活有时会把你击倒，但你必须继续前行。

e.en: She always {knocks} twice before opening the office door.
e.zh: 她进办公室门前总是先敲两下。

e.en: The picnic took place on a grassy {knoll} overlooking the lake.
e.zh: 野餐在一个俯瞰湖泊的草丘上举行。

e.en: Conspiracy theories often mention the grassy {knoll} in Dallas.
e.zh: 阴谋论中经常提到达拉斯的那个草丘。

e.en: Alfred A. {Knopf} is a prestigious American publishing house.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·A·克诺夫是美国一家声誉卓著的出版社。

e.en: The novel was published by {Knopf} to wide critical acclaim.
e.zh: 这部小说由克诺夫出版社出版，广受好评。

knossos.t: n. 克诺索斯（古希腊遗址）

e.en: We visited the ancient ruins of {Knossos} on the island of Crete.
e.zh: 我们参观了克里特岛上克诺索斯的古代遗址。

e.en: {Knossos} was the center of the Minoan civilization.
e.zh: 克诺索斯是米诺斯文明的中心。

knot.t:
n. 结；节（航速）
v. 打结

e.en: He tied a tight {knot} in his shoelaces before the race.
e.zh: 赛跑前他把鞋带打了个紧紧的结。

e.en: My stomach was in a {knot} before the job interview.
e.zh: 面试前我的胃紧张得纠成一团。

e.en: Sunlight peeked through a {knothole} in the wooden fence.
e.zh: 阳光透过木栅栏上的一个节疤洞射了进来。

e.en: The squirrel hid acorns in a {knothole} of the old oak.
e.zh: 松鼠把橡子藏在老橡树的一个节疤洞里。

e.en: The sailor knows how to tie many different {knots}.
e.zh: 那位水手会打很多种不同的绳结。

e.en: My back has painful {knots} from sitting at my desk.
e.zh: 久坐让我的背部出现了疼痛的肌肉结节。

e.en: Her hair was {knotted} after a windy day at the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩刮了一天风后她的头发打结了。

e.en: He {knotted} his tie carefully before the big meeting.
e.zh: 重要会议前他仔细打好了领带。

e.en: The lawyer faced a {knotty} legal problem with no easy solution.
e.zh: 律师面临一个棘手的法律难题，没有简单的解决办法。

e.en: The cabin walls were made of beautiful {knotty} pine wood.
e.zh: 小木屋的墙壁是用漂亮的多节松木做的。

e.en: I {know} a great coffee shop near the office.
e.zh: 我知道办公室附近一家很棒的咖啡店。

e.en: Do you {know} how to reset the router?
e.zh: 你知道怎么重置路由器吗？

know-how.t: n. 专业知识；技术诀窍

e.en: This project requires technical {know-how} that few engineers possess.
e.zh: 这个项目需要很少工程师才具备的专业技术。

e.en: She has the business {know-how} to run a successful startup.
e.zh: 她拥有经营成功创业公司所需的商业技能。

knowable.t: adj. 可知的；能被了解的

e.en: Some questions about the universe may never be {knowable}.
e.zh: 关于宇宙的一些问题或许永远无法被知晓。

e.en: The exact cause of the crash is not yet {knowable}.
e.zh: 事故的确切原因目前还无法得知。

e.en: In philosophy, the {knower} is distinct from the thing known.
e.zh: 在哲学中，认知者与被认知的事物是有区别的。

e.en: She presents herself as the all-{knower} in every meeting.
e.zh: 她在每次会议上都把自己塑造成无所不知的人。

knowhow.t: n. 技术诀窍；专门知识

e.en: The startup lacked the technical {knowhow} to scale quickly.
e.zh: 这家初创公司缺乏快速扩张所需的技术专长。

e.en: Years of experience gave her the {knowhow} to fix anything.
e.zh: 多年的经验让她拥有修理任何东西的本领。

e.en: She gave him a {knowing} smile across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他露出会心的微笑。

e.en: There's no way of {knowing} how the meeting will end.
e.zh: 无从知道这场会议会如何收场。

e.en: He {knowingly} signed the contract without reading it.
e.zh: 他明知故犯地没看就签了合同。

e.en: She nodded {knowingly} when I mentioned the surprise party.
e.zh: 我提到惊喜派对时她心领神会地点点头。

e.en: His writing has a clever {knowingness} about pop culture.
e.zh: 他的文字透着对流行文化的精明洞察。

e.en: The film's {knowingness} appeals to longtime fans.
e.zh: 这部电影的内行感吸引了老粉丝。

e.en: The clerk was {knowledgable} about every product on the shelf.
e.zh: 店员对架上每件商品都了如指掌。

e.en: We need a {knowledgable} guide for the museum tour.
e.zh: 我们需要一位博学的导览员带我们参观博物馆。

e.en: His {knowledge} of Japanese history impressed the professor.
e.zh: 他对日本历史的了解让教授刮目相看。

e.en: To my {knowledge}, the office closes at six.
e.zh: 据我所知,办公室六点关门。

e.en: She's incredibly {knowledgeable} about indie music.
e.zh: 她对独立音乐了解得非常深入。

e.en: Ask a {knowledgeable} mechanic before buying a used car.
e.zh: 买二手车前请教一位懂行的技师。

e.en: He spoke {knowledgeably} about climate policy on the podcast.
e.zh: 他在播客中专业地谈论气候政策。

e.en: The barista discussed coffee origins {knowledgeably}.
e.zh: 咖啡师内行地聊起了咖啡产地。

known.t:
adj. 已知的；知名的
v. know 的过去分词

e.en: She's {known} for her sharp wit and honesty.
e.zh: 她以机智犀利和坦诚直率著称。

e.en: This bug has been {known} to crash older phones.
e.zh: 已知这个漏洞会让老款手机崩溃。

knows.t: v. know 的第三人称单数；知道、了解

e.en: Nobody {knows} the password to that old account.
e.zh: 没人知道那个旧账号的密码。

e.en: She {knows} how to handle difficult customers calmly.
e.zh: 她懂得如何冷静应对难缠的顾客。

e.en: {Knowsley} Safari Park is a popular weekend destination.
e.zh: 诺斯利野生动物园是热门的周末去处。

e.en: He grew up in a small village near {Knowsley}.
e.zh: 他在诺斯利附近的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: Fort {Knox} is famous for storing the gold reserves.
e.zh: 诺克斯堡因存放黄金储备而闻名。

e.en: My laptop is locked up tighter than Fort {Knox}.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑锁得比诺克斯堡还严实。

knuckle.t:
n. 指关节
v. 用指关节击打

e.en: He scraped his {knuckle} while fixing the bike.
e.zh: 他修自行车时擦破了指关节。

e.en: It's time to {knuckle} down and finish the report.
e.zh: 该认真埋头把报告写完了。

knuckleball.t: n. 蝴蝶球（棒球的一种投法）

e.en: His {knuckleball} dances unpredictably toward the plate.
e.zh: 他的蝴蝶球飘忽不定地飞向本垒板。

e.en: Catching a good {knuckleball} is nearly impossible.
e.zh: 接住一记漂亮的蝴蝶球几乎不可能。

e.en: The aging {knuckleballer} surprised everyone with a no-hitter.
e.zh: 那位老蝴蝶球投手投出无安打令所有人惊讶。

e.en: Few pitchers train as a dedicated {knuckleballer} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有投手专门练习蝴蝶球。

knuckleduster.t: n. 指虎（套在手指上的金属武器）

e.en: Police found a {knuckleduster} hidden in his jacket.
e.zh: 警方在他外套里发现了一副指虎。

e.en: Carrying a {knuckleduster} is illegal in many countries.
e.zh: 在许多国家携带指虎是违法的。

e.en: Some {knucklehead} parked across two spaces again.
e.zh: 又有哪个糊涂蛋占了两个停车位。

e.en: Don't be such a {knucklehead} about the rules.
e.zh: 别在规矩上犯这种糊涂。

knurled.t: adj. 表面有滚花纹的（便于防滑）

e.en: The {knurled} grip prevents the screwdriver from slipping.
e.zh: 滚花的握柄能防止螺丝刀打滑。

e.en: Camera lenses often have a {knurled} focus ring.
e.zh: 相机镜头通常配有滚花的对焦环。

knutsford.t: n. 纳茨福德（英国地名）

e.en: {Knutsford} is a charming market town in Cheshire.
e.zh: 纳茨福德是柴郡一座迷人的集市小镇。

e.en: We stopped for tea on the way to {Knutsford}.
e.zh: 我们去纳茨福德的路上停下来喝了茶。

e.en: A sleepy {koala} clung to the eucalyptus branch.
e.zh: 一只困倦的考拉抱在桉树枝上。

e.en: Bushfires destroyed much of the {koala} habitat.
e.zh: 丛林大火摧毁了大部分考拉栖息地。

koan.t: n. 公案（禅宗的思辨题）

e.en: The Zen master posed a puzzling {koan} to his students.
e.zh: 禅师向弟子们抛出一个令人费解的公案。

e.en: Solving a {koan} requires intuition rather than logic.
e.zh: 参透公案靠的是直觉而非逻辑。

koblenz.t: n. 科布伦茨（德国城市）

e.en: {Koblenz} sits where the Rhine meets the Moselle.
e.zh: 科布伦茨坐落在莱茵河与摩泽尔河的交汇处。

e.en: We took a riverboat from {Koblenz} to Mainz.
e.zh: 我们从科布伦茨乘游船去了美因茨。

e.en: That sunset was a perfect {Kodak} moment.
e.zh: 那场日落真是值得珍藏的柯达瞬间。

e.en: My grandfather still owns an old {Kodak} camera.
e.zh: 我祖父还留着一台老式柯达相机。

kohl.t: n. 眼线粉（中东、印度常用化妆品）

e.en: She lined her eyes with dark {kohl} before the show.
e.zh: 演出前她用深色眼线粉描了眼睛。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians used {kohl} both for beauty and protection.
e.zh: 古埃及人涂眼线粉既为美观也为防护。

e.en: I roasted some {kohlrabi} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 我用蒜和橄榄油烤了一些苤蓝。

e.en: {Kohlrabi} tastes like a milder, sweeter cabbage.
e.zh: 苤蓝吃起来像味道更温和、更甜的卷心菜。

e.en: Bright {koi} swam lazily around the temple pond.
e.zh: 色彩鲜艳的锦鲤在寺庙池塘里悠然游动。

e.en: Raising {koi} requires careful water filtration.
e.zh: 养锦鲤需要精心过滤水质。

kojak.t: n. 科杰克（美剧主角名）

e.en: His shaved head earned him the nickname {Kojak}.
e.zh: 他剃光头后得了个外号叫光头神探。

e.en: The detective sucked a lollipop just like {Kojak}.
e.zh: 那位探长像光头神探一样含着棒棒糖。

e.en: The Dutch surname {Kok} means "cook" in English.
e.zh: 荷兰姓氏库克在英语里意为厨师。

e.en: Wim {Kok} served as Prime Minister of the Netherlands.
e.zh: 维姆·库克曾担任荷兰首相。

kokanee.t: n. 陆封红鲑（一种淡水三文鱼）

e.en: Anglers love fishing for {kokanee} in mountain lakes.
e.zh: 垂钓者喜欢在山间湖里钓陆封红鲑。

e.en: The {kokanee} turned bright red during spawning season.
e.zh: 陆封红鲑在产卵季变得通红。

koko.t: n. 可可（名字，常指会手语的大猩猩）

e.en: {Koko} the gorilla famously learned sign language.
e.zh: 大猩猩可可因学会手语而闻名。

e.en: Researchers studied how {Koko} communicated her emotions.
e.zh: 研究人员观察可可如何表达她的情绪。

kola.t: n. 可乐果（含咖啡因的非洲果实）

e.en: West African hosts often offer guests a {kola} nut.
e.zh: 西非主人常用可乐果招待客人。

e.en: Original sodas were flavored with extract from the {kola} nut.
e.zh: 最早的汽水是用可乐果提取物调味的。

kolkhoz.t: n. 集体农庄（苏联时期的）

e.en: Her grandparents worked on a Soviet {kolkhoz} for decades.
e.zh: 她的祖父母在苏联集体农庄干了几十年。

e.en: Each {kolkhoz} was expected to meet strict grain quotas.
e.zh: 每个集体农庄都要完成严格的粮食指标。

kong.t: n. 金刚（常指 King Kong）

e.en: King {Kong} climbed the Empire State Building in the film.
e.zh: 片中金刚爬上了帝国大厦。

e.en: Donkey {Kong} remains one of Nintendo's iconic characters.
e.zh: 大金刚至今仍是任天堂的标志性角色之一。

e.en: The pigeons let out a soft {koo} from the rooftop.
e.zh: 鸽子在屋顶上发出轻柔的咕咕声。

e.en: South Korean app {Koo} attracted millions of new users.
e.zh: 韩国应用Koo吸引了数百万新用户。

e.en: The neighbors think he's a harmless {kook}.
e.zh: 邻居们觉得他是个无害的怪人。

e.en: Don't dismiss her ideas just because she seems like a {kook}.
e.zh: 别因为她看起来古怪就否定她的想法。

e.en: She wore a {kooky} hat with feathers and bells.
e.zh: 她戴了一顶古怪的帽子,上面有羽毛和铃铛。

e.en: The shop sells {kooky} gifts you can't find elsewhere.
e.zh: 那家店卖一些别处找不到的稀奇古怪的礼物。

kooning.t: n. 库宁（姓氏，常指画家 de Kooning）

e.en: De {Kooning} pioneered abstract expressionism in postwar America.
e.zh: 德库宁在战后美国开创了抽象表现主义。

e.en: The museum hung a massive de {Kooning} canvas in the lobby.
e.zh: 博物馆在大堂挂了一幅巨幅德库宁画作。

kop.t: n. 球场看台（尤指利物浦主场的 The Kop）

e.en: Liverpool fans on the {Kop} sang throughout the match.
e.zh: 利物浦球迷在科普看台上整场高歌不停。

e.en: He's stood on the {Kop} for every home game.
e.zh: 他每场主场赛都站在科普看台上观战。

e.en: This old coin is worth a single Russian {kopeck}.
e.zh: 这枚旧硬币只值一戈比。

e.en: He didn't have a {kopeck} left after paying rent.
e.zh: 付完房租后他连一个戈比都没剩下。

kopje.t: n. 南非草原上的小石丘

e.en: A small {kopje} rose above the dry African plain.
e.zh: 干旱的非洲平原上耸立着一座小石丘。

e.en: The lions rested in the shade of a {kopje}.
e.zh: 狮子们在小石丘的阴影下休息。

kora.t: n. 科拉琴（西非传统竖琴）

e.en: He played the {kora} with mesmerizing skill.
e.zh: 他演奏科拉琴的技艺令人陶醉。

e.en: The {kora} is a 21-string harp from West Africa.
e.zh: 科拉琴是西非一种二十一弦的竖琴。

koran.t: n. 古兰经（伊斯兰教经典）

e.en: He recited verses from the {Koran} every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早晨都诵读古兰经的章节。

e.en: The bookshop carries translations of the {Koran} in many languages.
e.zh: 那家书店出售多种语言的古兰经译本。

koranic.t: adj. 古兰经的、与古兰经相关的

e.en: The school offers {Koranic} studies after regular classes.
e.zh: 那所学校在正课之后开设古兰经课程。

e.en: Children memorize {Koranic} verses from a young age.
e.zh: 孩子们从小就背诵古兰经经文。

e.en: South {Korea} is famous for its dynamic pop music industry.
e.zh: 韩国以充满活力的流行音乐产业闻名。

e.en: She's planning a backpacking trip across {Korea} next spring.
e.zh: 她打算明年春天背包游遍韩国。

korean.t:
adj. 韩国的；朝鲜的
n. 韩语；韩国人

e.en: He's been studying {Korean} on his commute every day.
e.zh: 他每天通勤路上都在学韩语。

e.en: This {Korean} barbecue place has the best short ribs.
e.zh: 这家韩式烤肉店的牛小排最棒。

korma.t: n. 考尔马咖喱（印度奶油咖喱菜）

e.en: I ordered the chicken {korma} with extra naan bread.
e.zh: 我点了鸡肉咖喱配额外的烤饼。

e.en: A good {korma} balances cream, almonds, and warm spices.
e.zh: 一份好的咖喱要把奶油、杏仁和香料平衡得恰到好处。

e.en: {Korn} headlined the festival's heavy metal stage Saturday night.
e.zh: 科恩乐队在音乐节周六晚的重金属舞台担任压轴。

e.en: Their playlist starts with classic {Korn} tracks from the 90s.
e.zh: 他们的歌单从九十年代经典的科恩乐队曲目开始。

e.en: We rented a scooter to explore the island of {Kos}.
e.zh: 我们租了一辆踏板车环游科斯岛。

e.en: {Kos} has beautiful beaches and ancient Greek ruins.
e.zh: 科斯岛拥有美丽的海滩和古希腊遗迹。

kosher.t:
adj. (食物) 符合犹太教规的
adj. 正当合规的

e.en: This deli only serves strictly {kosher} meat.
e.zh: 这家熟食店只供应严格符合犹太教规的肉类。

e.en: Something about that deal doesn't feel quite {kosher}.
e.zh: 那笔交易总让人觉得不太靠谱。

e.en: {Kosovo} declared independence from Serbia in 2008.
e.zh: 科索沃于2008年宣布脱离塞尔维亚独立。

e.en: She volunteered as a teacher in rural {Kosovo}.
e.zh: 她在科索沃乡村当过志愿教师。

e.en: The night market in {Kowloon} is packed every weekend.
e.zh: 九龙的夜市每个周末都人头攒动。

e.en: We took the ferry from Central to {Kowloon} at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时分乘渡轮从中环去九龙。

kowtow.t:
v. 叩头；卑躬屈膝
n. 磕头

e.en: He refused to {kowtow} to the demands of his boss.
e.zh: 他拒绝向老板的要求低头屈服。

e.en: In ancient China, subjects would {kowtow} before the emperor.
e.zh: 在古代中国，臣民要在皇帝面前叩头行礼。

kph.t: n. 公里/小时（kilometers per hour）

e.en: The speed limit on this highway is 100 {kph}.
e.zh: 这条高速公路的限速是每小时100公里。

e.en: The car can accelerate from 0 to 100 {kph} in five seconds.
e.zh: 这辆车能在五秒内从0加速到每小时100公里。

kpmg.t: n. 毕马威（四大会计师事务所之一）

e.en: She landed an internship at {KPMG} after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后她在毕马威获得了一份实习工作。

e.en: {KPMG} is one of the Big Four accounting firms worldwide.
e.zh: 毕马威是全球四大会计师事务所之一。

kraal.t: n. 南非土著村寨；畜栏

e.en: The villagers drove the cattle into the {kraal} at sunset.
e.zh: 村民们在日落时把牛群赶进畜栏。

e.en: A traditional Zulu {kraal} consists of huts arranged in a circle.
e.zh: 传统的祖鲁人村落由围成圆圈的茅屋组成。

kraft.t:
n. 牛皮纸
n. 卡夫（品牌）

e.en: She wrapped the gift in plain brown {kraft} paper.
e.zh: 她用普通的牛皮纸包裹了礼物。

e.en: The bakery uses {kraft} bags to package fresh bread.
e.zh: 这家面包店用牛皮纸袋包装新鲜面包。

e.en: The {krait} is one of the most venomous snakes in Asia.
e.zh: 金环蛇是亚洲毒性最强的蛇之一。

e.en: Hikers were warned about a {krait} spotted on the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者被警告小径上出现了一条环蛇。

e.en: The {Krajina} region was a flashpoint during the Yugoslav wars.
e.zh: 克拉伊纳地区在南斯拉夫战争期间是冲突焦点。

e.en: Many Serbs fled {Krajina} after the 1995 military operation.
e.zh: 1995年军事行动后，许多塞族人逃离了克拉伊纳。

e.en: The eruption of {Krakatoa} in 1883 was heard thousands of miles away.
e.zh: 1883年喀拉喀托火山的爆发声在数千英里外都能听到。

e.en: {Krakatoa} remains one of history's most destructive volcanic events.
e.zh: 喀拉喀托火山仍是史上最具破坏性的火山事件之一。

e.en: Sailors once feared the legendary {kraken} would drag ships down.
e.zh: 水手们曾害怕传说中的海怪会把船只拖入海底。

e.en: The movie features a giant {kraken} attacking the pirate ship.
e.zh: 电影里有一只巨大的海怪袭击海盗船。

krakow.t: n. 克拉科夫（波兰城市）

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the old town of {Krakow}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览克拉科夫的老城区。

e.en: {Krakow} is famous for its medieval architecture and rich history.
e.zh: 克拉科夫以中世纪建筑和悠久历史而闻名。

e.en: {Kramer} is one of the most iconic characters from Seinfeld.
e.zh: 克莱默是《宋飞正传》中最具代表性的角色之一。

e.en: Mr. {Kramer} burst through the door without knocking again.
e.zh: 克莱默先生又一次没敲门就破门而入。

e.en: The ancient Greek {krater} was used to mix wine and water.
e.zh: 古希腊的调酒缸用来调和葡萄酒和水。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed a beautifully painted {krater} at the site.
e.zh: 考古学家在遗址出土了一只绘饰精美的调酒缸。

kraut.t:
n. 德国人（贬称）
n. 德式酸菜

e.en: He topped the hot dog with mustard and {kraut}.
e.zh: 他在热狗上加了芥末和酸菜。

e.en: My grandmother makes homemade {kraut} every autumn.
e.zh: 我奶奶每年秋天都会自制德式酸菜。

kremlin.t: n. 克里姆林宫；俄罗斯政府

e.en: The {Kremlin} issued a statement denying any involvement.
e.zh: 克里姆林宫发表声明否认有任何牵连。

e.en: Tourists lined up to visit the {Kremlin} in Moscow.
e.zh: 游客们排队参观莫斯科的克里姆林宫。

e.en: Blue whales feed on enormous quantities of {krill} each day.
e.zh: 蓝鲸每天都要吃掉大量的磷虾。

e.en: {Krill} oil supplements have become popular for heart health.
e.zh: 磷虾油保健品因有益心脏健康而日益受欢迎。

e.en: He inherited an antique {kris} dagger from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一把古董波形剑。

e.en: The Indonesian {kris} is known for its distinctive wavy blade.
e.zh: 印尼克里斯剑以其独特的波浪形剑刃而闻名。

e.en: Devotees gathered at the temple to celebrate {Krishna}'s birthday.
e.zh: 信徒们聚集在寺庙里庆祝克里希纳的诞辰。

e.en: Stories of {Krishna} are central to Hindu mythology.
e.zh: 克里希纳的故事是印度教神话的核心内容。

kristallnacht.t: n. 水晶之夜（纳粹反犹暴行事件）

e.en: {Kristallnacht} marked a turning point in Nazi persecution of Jews.
e.zh: 水晶之夜是纳粹迫害犹太人的一个转折点。

e.en: Synagogues across Germany were destroyed during {Kristallnacht}.
e.zh: 水晶之夜期间，德国各地的犹太教堂遭到毁坏。

krone.t: n. 克朗（北欧货币单位）

e.en: The price was listed in Norwegian {krone} on the menu.
e.zh: 菜单上的价格是用挪威克朗标示的。

e.en: I exchanged some euros for the Danish {krone} at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场把一些欧元换成了丹麦克朗。

e.en: The hotel charged us two thousand {kroner} per night.
e.zh: 酒店每晚向我们收取两千克朗。

e.en: He had a few hundred {kroner} left over from his trip.
e.zh: 他旅行后还剩下几百克朗。

kruger.t: n. 克鲁格（姓氏/南非国家公园）

e.en: We spotted lions on safari in {Kruger} National Park.
e.zh: 我们在克鲁格国家公园游猎时看到了狮子。

e.en: {Kruger} is one of the largest game reserves in Africa.
e.zh: 克鲁格是非洲最大的野生动物保护区之一。

krupp.t: n. 克虏伯（德国工业集团）

e.en: The {Krupp} family built a steel empire in nineteenth-century Germany.
e.zh: 克虏伯家族在十九世纪的德国建立起钢铁帝国。

e.en: {Krupp} factories supplied much of Germany's wartime weaponry.
e.zh: 克虏伯工厂为德国战时提供了大量武器装备。

e.en: Superman was born on the distant planet {Krypton}.
e.zh: 超人出生在遥远的氪星上。

e.en: {Krypton} is a noble gas used in some specialized lighting.
e.zh: 氪是一种惰性气体，用于某些特殊照明设备。

kuala.t: n. 瓜拉（马来地名前缀，如吉隆坡）

e.en: Our flight has a layover in {Kuala} Lumpur for six hours.
e.zh: 我们的航班在吉隆坡转机停留六个小时。

e.en: {Kuala} Lumpur is the bustling capital city of Malaysia.
e.zh: 吉隆坡是马来西亚繁华的首都。

e.en: Many homes display a statue of {Kuan} Yin for protection.
e.zh: 许多家庭供奉观音像以求庇佑。

e.en: {Kuan} Yin is revered as the goddess of mercy in Buddhism.
e.zh: 观音在佛教中被尊为慈悲的女神。

e.en: Coleridge's poem famously begins with {Kubla} Khan's pleasure dome.
e.zh: 柯尔律治的诗以忽必烈的逍遥宫开篇而闻名。

e.en: {Kubla} Khan ruled over a vast Mongol empire in China.
e.zh: 忽必烈汗统治着中国境内庞大的蒙古帝国。

kudo.t: n. 赞扬；荣誉（kudos 的单数回构）

e.en: She received a {kudo} from her manager for the brilliant presentation.
e.zh: 她因出色的演讲获得了经理的一句称赞。

e.en: Every {kudo} on the running app makes me want to train harder.
e.zh: 跑步应用上的每一个点赞都让我更想加紧训练。

e.en: {Kudos} to the team for shipping the feature on time.
e.zh: 为按时上线功能的团队点赞。

e.en: She earned {kudos} for her quick thinking during the crisis.
e.zh: 她在危机中反应敏捷，赢得了大家的赞誉。

e.en: A male {kudu} can have spectacular spiral horns over a meter long.
e.zh: 雄性大羚羊可以长出一米多长的壮观螺旋状角。

e.en: We watched a herd of {kudu} grazing near the watering hole.
e.zh: 我们看着一群大羚羊在水坑边吃草。

kudzu.t: n. 葛藤（一种攀缘植物）

e.en: {Kudzu} vines have completely covered the abandoned barn.
e.zh: 葛藤已经完全覆盖了那座废弃的谷仓。

e.en: The invasive {kudzu} is notoriously difficult to remove from gardens.
e.zh: 入侵性的葛藤以极难从花园中清除而著称。

kugel.t: n. 库格尔（犹太传统烤布丁）

e.en: My aunt makes a delicious noodle {kugel} for every holiday dinner.
e.zh: 我姑姑每个节日晚餐都会做美味的面条布丁。

e.en: Sweet potato {kugel} is a traditional Jewish comfort food.
e.zh: 红薯库格尔是一道传统的犹太家常美食。

kulak.t: n. 富农（旧俄罗斯的富裕农民）

e.en: Stalin's regime targeted the {kulak} class during collectivization.
e.zh: 斯大林政权在集体化运动中打击富农阶级。

e.en: Many a {kulak} was deported to Siberia in the 1930s.
e.zh: 1930年代许多富农被流放到西伯利亚。

e.en: I love eating a whole {kumquat}, skin and all.
e.zh: 我喜欢连皮一起吃整颗金桔。

e.en: She planted a {kumquat} tree in her backyard last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在后院种了一棵金桔树。

kundalini.t: n. 昆达里尼（瑜伽中的灵能）

e.en: She practices {kundalini} yoga every morning to start her day.
e.zh: 她每天早晨练习昆达里尼瑜伽来开启一天。

e.en: {Kundalini} is described as spiritual energy coiled at the spine's base.
e.zh: 昆达里尼被描述为盘绕在脊柱底部的灵性能量。

kung.t: n. 功（常见于 kung fu 功夫）

e.en: He has practiced {kung} fu since he was six years old.
e.zh: 他从六岁起就开始练习功夫。

e.en: The new {kung} fu movie broke box office records this weekend.
e.zh: 这部新功夫片在本周末打破了票房纪录。

e.en: The {Kuomintang} fled to Taiwan after losing the civil war.
e.zh: 国民党在内战失败后撤退到台湾。

e.en: Sun Yat-sen founded the {Kuomintang} in the early twentieth century.
e.zh: 孙中山在二十世纪初创建了国民党。

e.en: A {Kurd} from northern Iraq shared his family's story with us.
e.zh: 一位来自伊拉克北部的库尔德人向我们讲述了他家的故事。

e.en: Every {Kurd} I met spoke passionately about their homeland.
e.zh: 我遇到的每一位库尔德人都满怀热情地谈论自己的家乡。

kurdish.t:
adj. 库尔德人的
n. 库尔德语

e.en: She is learning {Kurdish} to communicate with her relatives.
e.zh: 她正在学习库尔德语，以便和亲戚交流。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Kurdish} dishes from the mountains.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应来自山区的传统库尔德菜肴。

kurdistan.t: n. 库尔德斯坦（地区名）

e.en: He spent a year working as a journalist in {Kurdistan}.
e.zh: 他在库尔德斯坦做了一年记者。

e.en: The mountains of {Kurdistan} stretch across four different countries.
e.zh: 库尔德斯坦的群山横跨四个不同的国家。

e.en: He wore a white cotton {kurta} to the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 他穿着一件白色棉质长衫参加婚礼。

e.en: She paired her embroidered {kurta} with simple silver earrings.
e.zh: 她把绣花长衫搭配了简约的银耳环。

e.en: Financial analysts watch for high {kurtosis} when assessing investment risk.
e.zh: 金融分析师在评估投资风险时会关注高峰度。

e.en: The dataset showed positive {kurtosis}, indicating heavy tails.
e.zh: 该数据集显示出正峰度，表明分布有厚尾特征。

e.en: Colonel {Kurtz} is the haunting villain in Apocalypse Now.
e.zh: 库尔兹上校是《现代启示录》中令人难忘的反派。

e.en: Conrad's {Kurtz} represents the corrupting power of unchecked ambition.
e.zh: 康拉德笔下的库尔兹象征着不受约束的野心的腐蚀力量。

e.en: My uncle has worked as an engineer in {Kuwait} for ten years.
e.zh: 我叔叔在科威特做工程师已经十年了。

e.en: {Kuwait} is one of the wealthiest countries in the Middle East.
e.zh: 科威特是中东最富有的国家之一。

kuwaiti.t:
adj. 科威特的
n. 科威特人

e.en: A {Kuwaiti} delegation arrived for trade talks this morning.
e.zh: 一支科威特代表团今天上午抵达进行贸易会谈。

e.en: The {Kuwaiti} dinar is one of the strongest currencies in the world.
e.zh: 科威特第纳尔是世界上最坚挺的货币之一。

e.en: We took a road trip through {KwaZulu}-Natal along the coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸自驾穿越了夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省。

e.en: {KwaZulu}-Natal is home to a rich Zulu cultural heritage.
e.zh: 夸祖鲁-纳塔尔拥有丰富的祖鲁文化遗产。

kwik.t: adj. 快捷的（quick 的变体拼写）

e.en: I stopped at the {Kwik} Mart to grab some snacks.
e.zh: 我顺路去了便利店买点零食。

e.en: The {Kwik} oil change took only fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 那家快速换油店只用了十五分钟就完成换油。

kymograph.t: n. 记波器（记录波形的仪器）

e.en: The lab uses a {kymograph} to record muscle contractions over time.
e.zh: 实验室使用记波仪来记录肌肉随时间的收缩情况。

e.en: Old physiology textbooks describe experiments using a rotating {kymograph}.
e.zh: 旧的生理学教科书描述了使用旋转记波仪的实验。

e.en: The temples of {Kyoto} look magical during cherry blossom season.
e.zh: 京都的寺庙在樱花季节看起来如梦似幻。

e.en: We stayed at a traditional ryokan during our trip to {Kyoto}.
e.zh: 我们去京都旅行时住在一家传统的旅馆里。

kyte.t:
n. 凯特（姓氏）
n. 〈方〉肚子

e.en: The colorful {kyte} soared high above the windy beach.
e.zh: 那只彩色的风筝在多风的海滩上空高高飞翔。

e.en: Children gathered to fly a giant {kyte} in the park.
e.zh: 孩子们聚在公园里放一只巨大的风筝。

e.en: {Kyushu} is the southernmost of Japan's four main islands.
e.zh: 九州是日本四大主岛中最南端的一个。

e.en: We soaked in the famous hot springs of {Kyushu}.
e.zh: 我们在九州著名的温泉里泡了澡。

keenest.t: a. 锋利的, 敏锐的, 强烈的, 敏捷的, 热心的, 渴望的\nn. 挽歌, 痛哭\nv. 唱挽歌, 痛哭

kindest.t: n. 种类, 性质, 方式\na. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的

kinkier.t: a. 弯曲的, 古怪的

knottiest.t: a. 有结的, 多节的, 多瘤的, 棘手的

knottier.t: a. 有结的, 多节的, 多瘤的, 棘手的

e.en: The register went {ka-ching} after every sale.
e.zh: 每卖出一件东西，收银机就哗啦一声进账。

e.en: Investors heard {ka-ching} when the deal closed.
e.zh: 交易完成时，投资者仿佛听见钱进账的声音。

e.en: They played {kabaddi} on the school field.
e.zh: 他们在学校操场上玩卡巴迪。

e.en: The {kabaddi} final drew a large crowd.
e.zh: 卡巴迪决赛吸引了大批观众。

e.en: He studied {kabala} with unusual devotion.
e.zh: 他以异乎寻常的投入研究卡巴拉神秘学。

e.en: The novel borrows symbols from {kabala}.
e.zh: 这部小说借用了卡巴拉神秘学中的符号。

e.en: She found {kabbala} difficult but fascinating.
e.zh: 她觉得卡巴拉神秘学很难，却也很迷人。

e.en: The lecture introduced {kabbala} to beginners.
e.zh: 这场讲座向初学者介绍了卡巴拉神秘学。

e.en: The old engine went {kablooey} on the hill.
e.zh: 那台旧发动机在山坡上砰的一声坏掉了。

e.en: Their careful plan went {kablooey} by noon.
e.zh: 到中午时，他们周密的计划彻底泡汤了。

e.en: She packed the whole {kaboodle} into one bag.
e.zh: 她把全部东西都塞进了一个包里。

e.en: We bought the kit and {kaboodle} together.
e.zh: 我们把工具包和所有配套东西一起买了。

e.en: Onions contain small amounts of {kaempferol}.
e.zh: 洋葱含有少量山柰酚。

e.en: Researchers measured {kaempferol} in the tea samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了茶样中的山柰酚含量。

e.en: The letter {kaf} appears in this Hebrew word.
e.zh: 字母卡夫出现在这个希伯来词中。

e.en: She practiced writing {kaf} in her notebook.
e.zh: 她在笔记本上练习书写卡夫这个字母。

e.en: They held a weekly {kaffeeklatsch} after church.
e.zh: 他们每周礼拜后都会举行咖啡闲聊聚会。

e.en: The meeting felt more like a {kaffeeklatsch}.
e.zh: 这次会议感觉更像是一场喝咖啡聊天的聚会。

e.en: The lord used a {kagemusha} to confuse enemies.
e.zh: 领主用影子替身迷惑敌人。

e.en: In the film, the {kagemusha} slowly accepts his role.
e.zh: 在影片中，那个替身武士慢慢接受了自己的角色。

e.en: The trader preferred a {kagi} chart for trends.
e.zh: 这名交易员更喜欢用日式钩形图表观察趋势。

e.en: A {kagi} line changes direction after a reversal.
e.zh: 日式钩形图表的线条会在反转后改变方向。

e.en: The traveler rode in a {kago} through the pass.
e.zh: 旅人坐着日式轿篮穿过山口。

e.en: A museum displayed an old {kago} from Edo.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一顶江户时期的旧日式轿篮。

e.en: The fisherman repaired his old {kaiak} before dawn.
e.zh: 渔夫在黎明前修好了他的旧皮划艇。

e.en: A traditional {kaiak} was built with a light frame.
e.zh: 传统的爱斯基摩小艇用轻便骨架制成。

e.en: She grew {kail} behind the cottage wall.
e.zh: 她在小屋后墙边种羽衣甘蓝。

e.en: The family ate hot {kail} on a cold evening.
e.zh: 一家人在寒冷的夜晚喝热菜汤。

e.en: The hens wandered through the {kailyard} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后，母鸡在菜园里四处走动。

e.en: Critics mocked the novel as sentimental {kailyard}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑这部小说是伤感的苏格兰乡土文学。

e.en: The mine shipped {kainit} to fertilizer factories.
e.zh: 这座矿把钾盐矿运往化肥厂。

e.en: Farmers once used {kainit} to enrich poor soil.
e.zh: 农民过去用钾盐矿来改良贫瘠土壤。

e.en: Geologists identified {kainite} in the evaporite layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在蒸发岩层中确认了钾盐矿。

e.en: The fertilizer contained powdered {kainite} from Germany.
e.zh: 这种肥料含有来自德国的钾盐矿粉。

kainogenesis.t: 新生性发育；演化新特征

e.en: The lecture contrasted {kainogenesis} with ancestral development.
e.zh: 讲座把新生性发育与祖先型发育作了对比。

e.en: Some larval traits may reflect {kainogenesis} rather than heredity.
e.zh: 某些幼体特征可能反映演化新特征，而非遗传本相。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {kairine} to reduce fever.
e.zh: 医生过去曾开凯林来退烧。

e.en: The old formulary listed {kairine} among antipyretics.
e.zh: 旧药典把凯林列在退热药之中。

e.en: The pharmacist mentioned {kairoline} in a historical note.
e.zh: 药剂师在一条历史注释中提到凯罗林。

e.en: Few modern doctors have ever used {kairoline}.
e.zh: 现代医生很少有人用过凯罗林。

e.en: The essay attacked {kaiserdom} as militaristic.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击德皇制度具有军国主义色彩。

e.en: After the war, {kaiserdom} became a symbol of the old order.
e.zh: 战后，皇帝统治成了旧秩序的象征。

e.en: The {kaiserin} appeared beside the emperor at court.
e.zh: 皇后在宫廷中出现在皇帝身旁。

e.en: Letters from the {kaiserin} revealed her political worries.
e.zh: 德皇夫人的信件透露了她的政治忧虑。

kaiserism.t: 德皇主义；专制军国主义

e.en: The pamphlet denounced {kaiserism} during the war.
e.zh: 这本小册子在战争期间谴责德皇主义。

e.en: They used {kaiserism} as a shorthand for autocratic rule.
e.zh: 他们用德皇主义来概括专制统治。

e.en: The calligrapher wrote the poem in {kaishu}.
e.zh: 书法家用楷书写下这首诗。

e.en: Students first practiced {kaishu} before trying cursive styles.
e.zh: 学生先练楷书，然后才尝试草书。

e.en: The factory adopted {kaizen} to reduce waste.
e.zh: 工厂采用持续改进法来减少浪费。

e.en: Her team treats {kaizen} as a daily habit.
e.zh: 她的团队把持续改进当作日常习惯。

e.en: She darkened her eyelids with {kajal}.
e.zh: 她用眼线膏把眼睑描深。

e.en: Traditional {kajal} was often kept in a small metal box.
e.zh: 传统的印度眼影粉常装在小金属盒里。

e.en: A {kaka} called from the forest canopy.
e.zh: 一只卡卡鹦鹉在森林树冠中鸣叫。

e.en: The guide identified the noisy bird as a {kaka}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只吵闹的鸟是卡卡鹦鹉。

e.en: The {kakapo} is a rare flightless parrot.
e.zh: 鸮鹦鹉是一种稀有的不会飞的鹦鹉。

e.en: Conservationists track each {kakapo} with a transmitter.
e.zh: 保护人员用发射器追踪每一只鸮鹦鹉。

e.en: Several {kakapos} live on protected islands.
e.zh: 几只鸮鹦鹉生活在受保护的岛屿上。

e.en: The team counted the young {kakapos} at night.
e.zh: 团队在夜间清点那些幼年鸮鹦鹉。

e.en: Two {kakas} landed near the hut.
e.zh: 两只卡卡鹦鹉落在小屋附近。

e.en: The sanctuary protects native {kakas} from predators.
e.zh: 保护区保护本土卡卡鹦鹉免受捕食者伤害。

e.en: A silk {kakemono} hung in the alcove.
e.zh: 一幅丝质日本挂轴画挂在壁龛里。

e.en: The collector carefully unrolled the old {kakemono}.
e.zh: 收藏家小心地展开那幅旧日本挂轴画。

e.en: She sliced a ripe {kaki} for dessert.
e.zh: 她切了一个熟柿子当甜点。

e.en: The uniform was made from coarse {kaki}.
e.zh: 那套制服是用粗卡其布做的。

e.en: The market sold sweet {kakis} in autumn.
e.zh: 市场在秋天出售甜柿子。

e.en: Old soldiers wore faded {kakis} in the parade.
e.zh: 老兵们穿着褪色的卡其制服参加游行。

e.en: Critics called the regime a {kakistocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者称这个政权是劣人统治。

e.en: The novel imagines a future {kakistocracy} run by fools.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了一个由蠢人掌权的未来恶政。

e.en: His {kakorrhaphiophobia} made every exam feel dangerous.
e.zh: 他的失败恐惧症让每场考试都像危险一样。

e.en: Therapy helped her discuss her {kakorrhaphiophobia} openly.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她坦然谈论自己的失败恐惧症。

e.en: The satire presents the city as a {kakotopia}.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品把这座城市写成恶劣社会。

e.en: He feared technology could create a new {kakotopia}.
e.zh: 他担心科技可能制造出新的反乌托邦。

e.en: The cook will {kalamein} the cabbage for soup.
e.zh: 厨师会把卷心菜粗切后用来煮汤。

e.en: Old recipes often tell you to {kalamein} vegetables first.
e.zh: 旧食谱常叫你先把蔬菜切成粗条。

e.en: The {kalameined} carrots went into the stew.
e.zh: 切成粗条的胡萝卜被放进炖菜里。

e.en: She served fish with {kalameined} greens beside it.
e.zh: 她端上鱼，并在旁边配了粗切青菜。

e.en: The teacher demonstrated sound waves with a {kaleidophone}.
e.zh: 老师用声振图案仪演示声波。

e.en: A {kaleidophone} makes vibrations visible as shifting patterns.
e.zh: 声振图案仪能把振动显示成变化的图案。

kaleidoscopical.t: 万花筒般的；纷繁变幻的

e.en: The dancer wore a {kaleidoscopical} costume of bright colors.
e.zh: 舞者穿着一套色彩明亮、万花筒般的服装。

e.en: His memories formed a {kaleidoscopical} sequence of images.
e.zh: 他的记忆组成了一串纷繁变幻的画面。

kaleidoscopically.t: 万花筒般地；纷繁变幻地

e.en: The lights shifted {kaleidoscopically} across the ceiling.
e.zh: 灯光在天花板上万花筒般地变换。

e.en: Her mood changed {kaleidoscopically} during the conversation.
e.zh: 谈话中她的情绪纷繁变幻。

e.en: The monk copied dates into the {kalendar}.
e.zh: 僧侣把日期抄进那本历书里。

e.en: The poem uses {kalendar} as an archaic spelling.
e.zh: 这首诗把kalendar用作calendar的古体拼法。

e.en: A wandering {kalender} appears in the old tale.
e.zh: 一个云游托钵僧出现在这个古老故事里。

e.en: The manuscript spells calendar as {kalender}.
e.zh: 这份手稿把calendar拼作古体的kalender。

e.en: Debts were often due on the {kalends}.
e.zh: 债务常在古罗马每月初一到期。

e.en: The historian explained the Roman {kalends} to students.
e.zh: 历史学家向学生解释古罗马的每月初一。

e.en: The old gardener kept a small {kaleyard} behind the cottage.
e.zh: 老园丁在小屋后面留着一小块羽衣甘蓝园。

e.en: Villagers gathered herbs from the shared {kaleyard}.
e.zh: 村民们从共用的菜园里采摘草药。

e.en: He packed the {kalian} with sweet tobacco.
e.zh: 他把甜味烟草装进水烟袋里。

e.en: The ornate {kalian} stood beside the low table.
e.zh: 那只装饰华丽的水烟壶放在矮桌旁。

e.en: The {kalif} ruled from a splendid palace.
e.zh: 那位哈里发在一座华丽的宫殿中统治。

e.en: Poets praised the generous {kalif} in ornate verses.
e.zh: 诗人们用华美的诗句赞颂那位慷慨的穆斯林统治者。

kalifate.t: 哈里发统治区；哈里发制度

e.en: The old {kalifate} controlled several trade routes.
e.zh: 这个古老的哈里发统治区控制着几条贸易路线。

e.en: Scholars debated the legal basis of the {kalifate}.
e.zh: 学者们讨论哈里发制度的法律基础。

e.en: She played a gentle tune on the {kalimba}.
e.zh: 她用卡林巴拇指琴弹了一段轻柔的旋律。

e.en: The musician amplified his {kalimba} for the concert.
e.zh: 那位音乐人为演出给他的卡林巴琴接上了扩音设备。

e.en: The chemist calibrated the {kalimeter} before testing the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在检测样品前校准了钾量计。

e.en: A broken {kalimeter} delayed the laboratory report.
e.zh: 一台损坏的钾测定仪耽误了实验室报告。

kalinka.t: 荚蒾浆果；俄罗斯民歌名

e.en: The song {Kalinka} made the audience clap along.
e.zh: 《卡林卡》这首歌让观众跟着拍手。

e.en: She embroidered red {kalinka} berries on the scarf.
e.zh: 她在围巾上绣了红色的荚蒾浆果。

e.en: The {kaliph} received envoys from distant kingdoms.
e.zh: 那位哈里发接见了来自远方王国的使节。

e.en: Legends describe a wise {kaliph} walking among his people.
e.zh: 传说中有一位贤明的穆斯林君主行走在百姓之间。

e.en: The museum displayed a pale specimen of {kalistrontite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块颜色很浅的钾锶矿标本。

e.en: Geologists identified {kalistrontite} in the evaporite deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在蒸发岩矿床中鉴定出了钾锶矿。

e.en: Older chemistry texts sometimes call potassium {kalium}.
e.zh: 较早的化学课本有时把钾称为kalium。

e.en: The symbol K comes from the Latin name {kalium}.
e.zh: 化学符号K来自钾的拉丁名称kalium。

e.en: The doctor noted the drug's {kaliuretic} effect.
e.zh: 医生注意到这种药有促钾排泄作用。

e.en: A {kaliuretic} diuretic can lower serum potassium.
e.zh: 促钾排泄的利尿剂可能降低血清钾水平。

e.en: The collector labeled the tiny crystal as {kalkowskite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那块微小晶体标注为卡尔科夫斯基石。

e.en: Few students had heard of {kalkowskite} before the mineralogy lecture.
e.zh: 在矿物学讲座之前，很少有学生听说过卡尔科夫斯基石。

e.en: Researchers measured {kallidin} levels in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织样本中的胰激肽水平。

e.en: The peptide {kallidin} can affect blood vessel dilation.
e.zh: 胰激肽这种肽会影响血管扩张。

e.en: The paper compared several {kallidreins} in human plasma.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了人血浆中的几种激肽释放酶类。

e.en: Abnormal {kallidreins} may influence inflammatory responses.
e.zh: 异常的激肽释放酶类可能影响炎症反应。

e.en: The enzyme {kallikrein} helps release active kinins.
e.zh: 激肽释放酶这种酶有助于释放活性激肽。

e.en: Doctors studied {kallikrein} as a possible disease marker.
e.zh: 医生们研究激肽释放酶能否作为疾病标志物。

e.en: The river curved past a quiet {kampong}.
e.zh: 河流绕过一个安静的东南亚村落。

e.en: Many families left the {kampong} for work in the city.
e.zh: 许多家庭离开乡村聚落，到城里工作。

e.en: The hallway was covered with worn {kamptulicon}.
e.zh: 走廊铺着磨旧的软木橡胶地毡。

e.en: Victorian builders sometimes chose {kamptulicon} for quiet floors.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的建筑商有时会选用这种地毡来降低脚步声。

e.en: A dusty {kamseen} swept across the desert road.
e.zh: 一阵夹尘的干热风掠过沙漠公路。

e.en: The old letters mention a fierce {kamseen} in spring.
e.zh: 那些旧信提到春天有一场猛烈的干热风。

e.en: The {kamsin} made the afternoon air heavy and hot.
e.zh: 干热风让下午的空气又闷又热。

e.en: Travelers waited indoors until the {kamsin} passed.
e.zh: 旅人们待在室内，等那阵干热风过去。

e.en: The tale describes a mountain {kamui} guarding the valley.
e.zh: 这个故事描写一位山中神灵守护着山谷。

e.en: In Ainu belief, a bear could be a {kamui}.
e.zh: 在阿伊努信仰中，熊可能是一位神灵。

kanaima.t: 圭亚那民俗中的复仇精怪

e.en: Villagers whispered that a {kanaima} haunted the trail.
e.zh: 村民低声说有个复仇精怪出没在那条小路上。

e.en: The novel turns the {kanaima} legend into political symbolism.
e.zh: 这部小说把复仇精怪的传说化成了政治象征。

e.en: The infection was treated with {kanamycin}.
e.zh: 这种感染用卡那霉素进行了治疗。

e.en: Researchers added {kanamycin} to select resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员加入卡那霉素来筛选耐药细菌。

e.en: The perfume used {kananga} oil for a sweet floral note.
e.zh: 这款香水使用卡南加油来带出甜美花香。

e.en: A {kananga} tree grew beside the tropical garden path.
e.zh: 一棵依兰类树长在热带花园的小路旁。

kanas.t: 假名字符；日文音节字母

e.en: The worksheet asks students to copy several {kanas}.
e.zh: 练习纸要求学生抄写几个假名字符。

e.en: Japanese learners usually study the two {kanas} first.
e.zh: 日语学习者通常先学习两套假名。

e.en: The team moved the card across the {kanban} board.
e.zh: 团队把那张卡片在任务看板上向前移动。

e.en: A factory can use {kanban} to control inventory.
e.zh: 工厂可以用看板管理来控制库存。

e.en: The lab tested {kanedomycin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 实验室用卡那霉素类抗生素测试了几种菌株。

e.en: Older papers sometimes list {kanedomycin} under antibiotic assays.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时在抗生素测定中列出这种药物。

e.en: Doctors rarely mention {kanendomycin} in modern treatment guides.
e.zh: 现代治疗指南中医生很少提到卡那霉素类抗生素。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {kanendomycin}.
e.zh: 样本中含有微量的这种卡那霉素类抗生素。

e.en: The florist added {kangaroo-paws} to the summer bouquet.
e.zh: 花店老板在夏日花束里加入了袋鼠爪花。

e.en: A red {kangaroo-paw} grows well in sandy soil.
e.zh: 红色袋鼠爪植物在沙质土壤里长得很好。

e.en: Some herbal shops sell {kanna} as a mood supplement.
e.zh: 一些草药店把卡纳草作为情绪补充品出售。

e.en: The guide explained that {kanna} has a long local history.
e.zh: 导游解释说，卡纳草在当地有很长的使用历史。

e.en: She learned {Kannada} before moving to Bengaluru.
e.zh: 她搬到班加罗尔前学了卡纳达语。

e.en: The library has a small {Kannada} literature section.
e.zh: 图书馆有一个小型卡纳达文学专区。

e.en: The musician tuned her {kanoon} before the concert.
e.zh: 音乐会前，乐手给她的卡农琴调了音。

e.en: A bright {kanoon} line carried the melody.
e.zh: 一段明亮的卡农琴旋律撑起了主旋律。

e.en: The bowl was made from polished {kansa}.
e.zh: 这个碗是用抛光的康萨青铜合金制成的。

e.en: Traditional healers sometimes use {kansa} wands for massage.
e.zh: 传统疗愈师有时会用康萨金属棒来按摩。

e.en: She played a quiet tune on the {kantele}.
e.zh: 她用康特勒琴弹了一首安静的曲子。

e.en: The old {kantele} hung on the cabin wall.
e.zh: 那把旧康特勒琴挂在小木屋的墙上。

e.en: He wore a white {kanzu} to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着白色坎祖长袍去参加婚礼。

e.en: The tailor pressed the {kanzu} until it looked crisp.
e.zh: 裁缝把那件坎祖长袍熨得很挺括。

e.en: They served strong {kaoliang} with dinner.
e.zh: 他们晚餐时上了烈性的高粱酒。

e.en: The farmer planted {kaoliang} on the dry hillside.
e.zh: 农民在干燥的山坡上种了高粱。

e.en: The factory mixed {kaoline} into the ceramic clay.
e.zh: 工厂把高岭土混进陶瓷泥料中。

e.en: Pure {kaoline} gives porcelain a pale color.
e.zh: 纯高岭土会让瓷器呈现浅淡的颜色。

e.en: The sample contained mostly {kaolinite} and quartz.
e.zh: 这个样本主要含有高岭石和石英。

e.en: Geologists identified {kaolinite} in the weathered rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在风化岩中识别出了高岭石。

kaolinize.t: 使高岭土化；变成高岭土

e.en: Hot fluids can {kaolinize} feldspar over time.
e.zh: 热液会随着时间使长石高岭土化。

e.en: The altered rock began to {kaolinize} near the fracture.
e.zh: 变质岩在裂隙附近开始变成高岭土质。

e.en: The detector recorded a rare {kaon} decay.
e.zh: 探测器记录到一次罕见的K介子衰变。

e.en: A charged {kaon} has a very short lifetime.
e.zh: 带电K介子的寿命非常短。

e.en: The team studied {kaonic} atoms in the lab.
e.zh: 团队在实验室研究了含K介子的原子。

e.en: Their paper described a possible {kaonic} nuclear state.
e.zh: 他们的论文描述了一种可能的K介子核态。

kallirotron.t: 早期机械排字照相装置

e.en: The museum displayed a {kallirotron} used for experimental printing.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台用于实验印刷的早期机械排字照相装置。

e.en: Few printers today have ever seen a working {kallirotron}.
e.zh: 如今很少有印刷工见过还能运转的这种装置。

e.en: The artist chose {kallitype} for its soft brown tones.
e.zh: 那位艺术家选择铁盐摄影印相法，因为它有柔和的棕色调。

e.en: A well-made {kallitype} can last for many decades.
e.zh: 制作精良的铁盐印相作品可以保存许多年。

e.en: The trail was lined with blooming {kalmia} in early summer.
e.zh: 初夏时，小径两旁开满了山月桂属植物的花。

e.en: Gardeners should remember that {kalmia} can be poisonous to livestock.
e.zh: 园丁应记住，山月桂属植物可能会毒害牲畜。

e.en: A large {kalong} flew silently over the trees.
e.zh: 一只大狐蝠静静地从树梢上飞过。

e.en: Island villagers sometimes call the fruit bat a {kalong}.
e.zh: 岛上村民有时把这种果蝠称作kalong。

e.en: In Buddhist cosmology, a {kalpa} spans an almost unimaginable length of time.
e.zh: 在佛教宇宙观中，一劫代表几乎无法想象的漫长时间。

e.en: The poet used {kalpa} to suggest endless waiting.
e.zh: 诗人用“劫”这个概念来暗示无尽的等待。

e.en: He wore a white {kalpak} during the winter festival.
e.zh: 冬季节庆时，他戴着一顶白色的中亚高筒毡帽。

e.en: The old photograph shows soldiers in heavy coats and {kalpaks}.
e.zh: 那张旧照片里，士兵们穿着厚外套，戴着毡帽。

e.en: They covered the ceiling with fresh {kalsomine}.
e.zh: 他们用新调的粉刷涂料刷了天花板。

e.en: The landlord decided to {kalsomine} the walls before renting the room.
e.zh: 房东决定在出租房间前用粉浆把墙刷白。

e.en: The doctor avoided a {kaluretic} because the patient already had low potassium.
e.zh: 医生没有使用促钾排泄的利尿药，因为病人的钾已经偏低。

e.en: Some older studies compare {kaluretic} drugs with potassium-sparing treatments.
e.zh: 一些较早的研究会比较促钾排泄药物和保钾治疗。

e.en: The diagram labels the outer supporting cell as a {kalymmocyte}.
e.zh: 图中把外层支持细胞标为鞘细胞。

e.en: Researchers described the {kalymmocyte} in their account of tissue development.
e.zh: 研究人员在组织发育说明中描述了这种包被细胞。

e.en: As a {kamaaina}, she knew which beaches were quiet after sunrise.
e.zh: 作为夏威夷本地老居民，她知道日出后哪些海滩比较安静。

e.en: The hotel offered a {kamaaina} discount to local residents.
e.zh: 酒店给当地居民提供了本地人折扣。

e.en: The meteorite sample contained bands of {kamacite} and taenite.
e.zh: 这块陨石样本含有镍铁矿物和铁纹石带。

e.en: Under the microscope, {kamacite} appears as a pale metallic phase.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，陨铁中的镍铁矿物呈现浅色金属相。

e.en: The clinic experimented with {kamagraphy} to record heat patterns in tissue.
e.zh: 诊所试用热疗摄影术来记录组织中的热分布。

e.en: Articles on early medical imaging sometimes mention {kamagraphy}.
e.zh: 早期医学成像的文章有时会提到热疗摄影术。

e.en: Traditional medicine used {kamalin} as a vermifuge.
e.zh: 传统医学曾把粗糠柴红色树脂粉用作驱虫药。

e.en: The apothecary kept {kamalin} in a small labeled jar.
e.zh: 药剂师把这种红色树脂粉装在一个贴有标签的小罐里。

e.en: A rounded {kame} rose above the flat valley floor.
e.zh: 一个圆形的冰川沉积丘高出平坦的谷底。

e.en: Geologists mapped each {kame} left by the retreating glacier.
e.zh: 地质学家标出了退缩冰川留下的每个沉积丘。

e.en: The old remedy included {kamela} mixed with honey.
e.zh: 这个老方子把粗糠柴粉和蜂蜜混在一起。

e.en: Pharmacists once sold {kamela} as a treatment for tapeworm.
e.zh: 药剂师过去曾把这种药粉作为绦虫治疗药出售。

e.en: The letter {kaph} appears in the old inscription.
e.zh: 字母卡夫出现在那段古老铭文中。

e.en: She learned to write {kaph} in Hebrew class.
e.zh: 她在希伯来语课上学会写卡夫这个字母。

e.en: The old radio is completely {kaputt}.
e.zh: 那台旧收音机彻底坏了。

e.en: After the scandal, his career was {kaputt}.
e.zh: 丑闻过后，他的事业算是完了。

e.en: Clip the rope to the {karabiner} before you climb.
e.zh: 攀爬前把绳子扣到登山扣上。

e.en: She kept her keys on a small {karabiner}.
e.zh: 她把钥匙挂在一个小安全扣上。

e.en: The coat was trimmed with black {karakul}.
e.zh: 那件外套用黑色卡拉库尔羊皮镶边。

e.en: Dealers prized fine {karakul} for winter hats.
e.zh: 商人很看重适合做冬帽的优质卡拉库尔羊皮。

e.en: The vintage collar was made of {karakule}.
e.zh: 那条复古衣领是用卡拉库尔羊皮做的。

e.en: A strip of {karakule} lined the heavy cap.
e.zh: 那顶厚帽子里衬着一条卡拉库尔羊皮。

e.en: Vonnegut called such a group a {karass}.
e.zh: 冯内古特把这样一群人称作命运牵连的群体。

e.en: Our odd little {karass} met every Friday.
e.zh: 我们这个古怪的小圈子每周五都会见面。

e.en: He used a playful {karate-chop} on the pillow.
e.zh: 他开玩笑似的对枕头使了一记空手道劈掌。

e.en: The actor {karate-chopped} the fake board in half.
e.zh: 那名演员用空手道劈掌把假木板劈成两半。

e.en: The young {karateist} trained before sunrise.
e.zh: 那位年轻的空手道练习者天亮前就开始训练。

e.en: A skilled {karateist} can move with great control.
e.zh: 熟练的空手道练习者动作控制力很强。

e.en: Each {karateka} bowed before entering the mat.
e.zh: 每位空手道练习者上垫前都鞠了一躬。

e.en: The experienced {karateka} taught beginners basic blocks.
e.zh: 那位经验丰富的空手道练习者教初学者基本格挡。

e.en: The label listed {karaya} as a thickening agent.
e.zh: 标签上把刺梧桐胶列为增稠剂。

e.en: Some adhesives once used {karaya} for extra body.
e.zh: 有些黏合剂过去会用刺梧桐胶来增加稠度。

e.en: The farmer applied {karbutilate} before weeds emerged.
e.zh: 杂草冒出前，农民施用了卡丁酸酯除草剂。

e.en: Regulators reviewed the use of {karbutilate} near streams.
e.zh: 监管人员审查了溪流附近使用卡丁酸酯除草剂的情况。

e.en: The geologist identified {karelianite} in the dark ore sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在那块深色矿石样本中鉴定出了卡累利阿矿。

e.en: Small grains of {karelianite} can occur with other vanadium minerals.
e.zh: 细小的卡累利阿矿颗粒可能与其他钒矿物共生。

e.en: The old {karez} carried groundwater to the village fields.
e.zh: 那条古老的坎儿井把地下水引到村里的田地。

e.en: Engineers studied the {karez} system before repairing the tunnels.
e.zh: 工程师在修复隧道前研究了这套坎儿井系统。

e.en: A traditional {kariz} brought water across the dry plain.
e.zh: 一条传统坎儿井把水引过干旱的平原。

e.en: The villagers cleaned the {kariz} before the irrigation season.
e.zh: 村民们在灌溉季到来前清理了那条地下水道。

e.en: The museum label described the specimen as {karlsteinite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这件标本描述为卡尔斯坦矿。

e.en: Researchers found {karlsteinite} in a rare mineral assemblage.
e.zh: 研究人员在一种罕见的矿物组合中发现了卡尔斯坦矿。

e.en: The documentary examined cases of {karoshi} among office workers.
e.zh: 这部纪录片调查了办公室职员中的过劳死案例。

e.en: Japan introduced reforms after public concern about {karoshi} grew.
e.zh: 公众对过劳死的担忧加深后，日本推出了改革措施。

e.en: He wrapped a warm {kaross} around his shoulders.
e.zh: 他把一条暖和的兽皮披毯裹在肩上。

e.en: The old {kaross} was made from carefully sewn animal skins.
e.zh: 那件旧皮斗篷由精心缝合的兽皮制成。

e.en: The thin green coating was later identified as {karpinskyite}.
e.zh: 那层薄薄的绿色覆盖物后来被鉴定为卡尔宾斯基矿。

e.en: Collectors rarely encounter {karpinskyite} outside specialized mineral shows.
e.zh: 收藏者在专业矿物展以外很少见到卡尔宾斯基矿。

karyomitosis.t: 细胞核有丝分裂；核分裂

e.en: The researcher described {karyomitosis} in the stained cells.
e.zh: 研究人员描述了染色细胞中的细胞核有丝分裂。

e.en: Abnormal {karyomitosis} can affect early embryonic development.
e.zh: 异常的核分裂会影响早期胚胎发育。

e.en: Each {karyon} contains the cell's genetic material.
e.zh: 每个细胞核都含有细胞的遗传物质。

e.en: The parasite has a clearly visible {karyon} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在显微镜下有清晰可见的细胞核。

e.en: The {karyonide} was examined during fertilization.
e.zh: 研究人员在受精过程中检查了配子核。

e.en: A damaged {karyonide} may prevent normal cell development.
e.zh: 受损的生殖核可能阻碍细胞正常发育。

e.en: The stain revealed {karyophans} inside the nucleus.
e.zh: 染色显示出细胞核内的显影物质。

e.en: Early cytologists studied {karyophans} with simple microscopes.
e.zh: 早期细胞学家用简易显微镜研究细胞核显影物质。

e.en: Proteins move through the {karyoplasm} during cell activity.
e.zh: 细胞活动时，蛋白质会在核质中移动。

e.en: The damaged nucleus showed changes in its {karyoplasm}.
e.zh: 受损细胞核的核质出现了变化。

e.en: The pathologist noted {karyopycnosis} in dying cells.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到濒死细胞中出现核固缩。

e.en: Severe injury may cause {karyopycnosis} before cell death.
e.zh: 严重损伤可能在细胞死亡前导致细胞核浓缩。

e.en: A dark {karyosome} appeared near the center of the nucleus.
e.zh: 一个深色的核仁样小体出现在细胞核中央附近。

e.en: The amoeba was identified by the position of its {karyosome}.
e.zh: 人们根据核小体的位置识别出这种变形虫。

e.en: The cell seemed to enter {karyostasis} after treatment.
e.zh: 处理后，这个细胞似乎进入了细胞核静止状态。

e.en: Prolonged {karyostasis} can signal disrupted cell division.
e.zh: 长期的细胞核静止状态可能表明细胞分裂受阻。

e.en: The slide showed {karyostenosis} in several damaged cells.
e.zh: 切片显示几个受损细胞出现细胞核狭缩。

e.en: Toxic stress sometimes produces {karyostenosis} before degeneration.
e.zh: 毒性压力有时会在退变前引起核缩窄。

e.en: She used {karyosystematics} to compare related plant species.
e.zh: 她用核型系统学比较相关的植物物种。

e.en: Modern {karyosystematics} combines chromosome data with morphology.
e.zh: 现代核型系统学把染色体数据和形态特征结合起来。

e.en: The {karyotheca} separates the nucleus from the cytoplasm.
e.zh: 核膜把细胞核与细胞质分隔开。

e.en: During division, the {karyotheca} breaks down and later reforms.
e.zh: 分裂时，细胞核膜会解体，随后重新形成。

e.en: Older texts described nuclear material as {karyotin}.
e.zh: 较早的文献把细胞核物质称为核质素。

e.en: The chemist tried to isolate {karyotin} from the cell nuclei.
e.zh: 这位化学家试图从细胞核中分离染色质物质。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {karyotype} to check the chromosomes.
e.zh: 医生安排做核型检查，以查看染色体情况。

e.en: A plant's {karyotype} can help distinguish closely related species.
e.zh: 植物的染色体组型有助于区分关系很近的物种。

e.en: The lab compared {karyotypes} from several patients.
e.zh: 实验室比较了几名患者的核型。

e.en: Different species may have very different {karyotypes}.
e.zh: 不同物种可能有很不一样的染色体组型。

e.en: Tourists wandered through the narrow lanes of the {kasbah}.
e.zh: 游客们在北非城堡区狭窄的小巷里漫步。

e.en: The old {kasbah} stood above the harbor.
e.zh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在港口上方。

e.en: The kitchen was made {kasher} before the holiday meal.
e.zh: 节日餐前，厨房按犹太教规整理成洁净状态。

e.en: Only {kasher} meat was served at the family dinner.
e.zh: 家庭晚餐只供应符合犹太教规的肉。

e.en: The restaurant follows {kashrut} very strictly.
e.zh: 这家餐厅严格遵守犹太饮食戒律。

e.en: She studied {kashrut} before preparing dinner for her guests.
e.zh: 她在为客人准备晚餐前学习了犹太饮食戒律。

e.en: The book explains {kashruth} for non-Jewish readers.
e.zh: 这本书向非犹太读者解释犹太饮食戒律。

e.en: Their household observes {kashruth} throughout the year.
e.zh: 他们家全年遵守犹太饮食戒律。

e.en: The mineral sample contained yellow {kasolite}.
e.zh: 这块矿物样本含有黄色的硅铀铅矿。

e.en: Collectors prize {kasolite} for its color and rarity.
e.zh: 收藏者因硅铀铅矿的颜色和稀有性而珍视它。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {katatonia} after the trauma.
e.zh: 创伤后，病人出现了紧张症迹象。

e.en: Severe depression can sometimes include {katatonia}.
e.zh: 严重抑郁有时会伴随紧张症。

e.en: The lab report mentioned abnormal {kathaemoglobin} levels.
e.zh: 化验报告提到高铁血红蛋白水平异常。

e.en: Doctors tested the sample for {kathaemoglobin} after poisoning was suspected.
e.zh: 怀疑中毒后，医生检测样本中的高铁血红蛋白。

e.en: Official documents were once written in {katharevousa}.
e.zh: 官方文件曾经使用希腊纯正语体书写。

e.en: Many modern readers find {katharevousa} stiff and formal.
e.zh: 许多现代读者觉得希腊纯正语体生硬而正式。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {katharobe} before testing the gas mixture.
e.zh: 技术员在测试混合气体前校准了气体导热率测定器。

e.en: A {katharobe} can detect changes in gas composition.
e.zh: 气体导热率测定器能检测气体成分的变化。

e.en: The laboratory used a {katharometer} to analyze hydrogen purity.
e.zh: 实验室用气体导热率分析仪分析氢气纯度。

e.en: A faulty {katharometer} gave inconsistent readings.
e.zh: 一台故障的气体导热率分析仪给出了不一致的读数。

e.en: The tragedy offered the audience a sense of {katharsis}.
e.zh: 这部悲剧让观众产生了一种情感净化的感觉。

e.en: Writing the letter became a private {katharsis} for her.
e.zh: 写这封信成了她私下宣泄情绪的方式。

e.en: Crying after the argument felt strangely {kathartic}.
e.zh: 争吵后哭出来反而有种奇妙的宣泄感。

e.en: The old remedy was used as a {kathartic} medicine.
e.zh: 这种老药方曾被用作通便药。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {kathetron} from a physics laboratory.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自物理实验室的早期阴极射线管。

e.en: Engineers studied the {kathetron} to improve electron-beam control.
e.zh: 工程师研究阴极射线管，以改进电子束控制。

e.en: Older textbooks sometimes spell cathode as {kathode}.
e.zh: 旧教材有时把阴极拼作kathode。

e.en: The current flowed toward the {kathode} in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中电流流向阴极。

e.en: A sodium {kation} carries a positive charge.
e.zh: 钠阳离子带有正电荷。

e.en: The membrane allows each {kation} to pass slowly.
e.zh: 这层膜允许每个阳离子缓慢通过。

e.en: The sheep grazed across the dry {karroo}.
e.zh: 羊群在干旱的南非高原灌丛地上吃草。

e.en: Spring flowers briefly colored the {karroo}.
e.zh: 春天的花短暂地点缀了这片卡鲁荒原。

e.en: Several {karroos} stretch across the interior plateau.
e.zh: 几片卡鲁干旱灌丛地横跨内陆高原。

e.en: Botanists compared plants from different {karroos}.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了不同卡鲁地区的植物。

e.en: His old coat was made of {karsey}.
e.zh: 他的旧外套是用粗呢布做的。

e.en: The tailor chose {karsey} for its toughness.
e.zh: 裁缝看中粗毛织物结实，便选用了它。

e.en: The valley has many {karstic} caves.
e.zh: 这个山谷有许多喀斯特洞穴。

e.en: Rainwater disappears quickly through {karstic} limestone.
e.zh: 雨水会很快渗入喀斯特石灰岩中。

e.en: Slow {karstification} formed the underground channels.
e.zh: 缓慢的喀斯特化作用形成了地下水道。

e.en: Geologists measured {karstification} in the limestone basin.
e.zh: 地质学家测量了石灰岩盆地中的喀斯特化程度。

e.en: She studies {karstology} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究喀斯特地貌学。

e.en: Modern {karstology} helps map hidden aquifers.
e.zh: 现代喀斯特地貌学有助于绘制隐伏含水层。

e.en: The old {kartell} controlled coal prices.
e.zh: 那个旧卡特尔控制着煤炭价格。

e.en: Historians examined the German {kartell} system.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了德国的卡特尔制度。

e.en: The microscope revealed a dividing {karyoblast}.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见一个正在分裂的成核细胞。

e.en: Early texts used {karyoblast} for a nuclear precursor cell.
e.zh: 早期文献用核母细胞指称细胞核前体细胞。

e.en: The stain made the {karyochrome} clearly visible.
e.zh: 染色剂使核染色质清晰可见。

e.en: Researchers compared {karyochrome} patterns in the samples.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了样本中的核染色质模式。

e.en: Each {karyocyte} contains a distinct nucleus.
e.zh: 每个有核细胞都含有清楚的细胞核。

e.en: The blood sample showed many abnormal {karyocytes}.
e.zh: 血液样本显示出许多异常的有核细胞。

e.en: Fungal reproduction often includes {karyogamy}.
e.zh: 真菌繁殖常常包括细胞核融合。

e.en: After {karyogamy}, the cell became diploid.
e.zh: 核配之后，这个细胞变成了二倍体。

e.en: The study described a {karyogenic} process in embryos.
e.zh: 这项研究描述了胚胎中的细胞核形成过程。

e.en: Certain proteins may have {karyogenic} functions.
e.zh: 某些蛋白质可能具有促成细胞核形成的功能。

e.en: The protozoan's {karyogonad} was noted in the diagram.
e.zh: 图中标出了这种原生动物的核性生殖腺。

e.en: Older zoology texts mention the {karyogonad} structure.
e.zh: 较早的动物学文献提到过核性生殖腺结构。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the child's {karyogram}.
e.zh: 医生查看了这个孩子的染色体核型图。

e.en: A {karyogram} can reveal missing chromosomes.
e.zh: 染色体核型图可以显示染色体缺失。

e.en: The cell contained a small {karyoid} body.
e.zh: 这个细胞含有一个小的似核小体。

e.en: Microscopy showed several {karyoid} structures near the center.
e.zh: 显微观察显示中心附近有几个似细胞核结构。

e.en: {Karyokinesis} precedes the division of the cytoplasm.
e.zh: 核分裂先于细胞质分裂发生。

e.en: The lecture contrasted {karyokinesis} with cytokinesis.
e.zh: 讲座把核分裂与胞质分裂进行了对比。

e.en: The team gathered {karyologic} evidence from tumor cells.
e.zh: 团队从肿瘤细胞中收集了细胞核学证据。

e.en: Her {karyologic} analysis focused on chromosome number.
e.zh: 她的细胞核学分析重点关注染色体数量。

e.en: {Karyology} examines the structure of cell nuclei.
e.zh: 细胞核学研究细胞核的结构。

e.en: Clinical {karyology} helps diagnose chromosomal disorders.
e.zh: 临床核型研究有助于诊断染色体异常疾病。

e.en: The {karyolymph} surrounds material inside the nucleus.
e.zh: 核液包围着细胞核内的物质。

e.en: Old histology manuals describe the {karyolymph} in detail.
e.zh: 旧组织学手册详细描述了核浆。

e.en: Severe injury can cause {karyolysis} in cells.
e.zh: 严重损伤会导致细胞发生核溶解。

e.en: Pathologists saw {karyolysis} in the dead tissue.
e.zh: 病理学家在坏死组织中看到了核溶解。

e.en: The parasite has a complex {karyomastigont}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫具有复杂的核鞭毛体复合体。

e.en: Researchers traced the {karyomastigont} during cell division.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了细胞分裂过程中的核鞭毛体复合体。

e.en: She ordered chicken {katsu} with rice for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了配米饭的日式炸鸡排。

e.en: The restaurant serves crispy pork {katsu} with curry.
e.zh: 这家餐馆供应配咖喱的酥脆日式炸猪排。

e.en: Sprinkle {katsuobushi} over the hot noodles.
e.zh: 把木鱼花撒在热面条上。

e.en: The broth gets its smoky flavor from {katsuobushi}.
e.zh: 这锅汤的烟熏香味来自柴鱼片。

e.en: A {katsura} tree shaded the garden path.
e.zh: 一棵连香树遮住了花园小径。

e.en: The leaves of the {katsura} turn golden in autumn.
e.zh: 日本桂树的叶子在秋天会变成金黄色。

e.en: He woke with a terrible {katzenjammer} after the party.
e.zh: 聚会后他醒来时宿醉得很厉害。

e.en: The meeting dissolved into pure {katzenjammer}.
e.zh: 会议最后变成一片喧闹混乱。

e.en: The old {kauri} stood above the forest track.
e.zh: 那棵古老的贝壳杉矗立在林间小路旁。

e.en: The table was made from polished {kauri}.
e.zh: 这张桌子是用打磨过的贝壳杉木做成的。

e.en: A tall {kaury} grew near the riverbank.
e.zh: 河岸附近长着一棵高大的贝壳杉。

e.en: They carved the panel from pale {kaury}.
e.zh: 他们用浅色贝壳杉木雕出这块镶板。

e.en: He carried a decorated {kavadi} during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间他扛着装饰过的印度教苦行肩架。

e.en: The {kavadi} ritual drew a large crowd.
e.zh: 这场扛苦行肩架的仪式吸引了大批人群。

e.en: The islanders prepared {kavakava} for the visitors.
e.zh: 岛民为来访者准备了卡瓦饮料。

e.en: Dried {kavakava} root is used in traditional ceremonies.
e.zh: 干卡瓦胡椒根会用于传统仪式。

e.en: A stern {kavass} guarded the embassy gate.
e.zh: 一名严肃的土耳其武装卫士守着使馆大门。

e.en: The consul traveled with a {kavass} for protection.
e.zh: 领事出行时带着一名武装卫士护卫。

e.en: Two {kavasses} stood beside the carriage.
e.zh: 两名土耳其武装卫士站在马车旁。

e.en: Foreign officials were escorted by {kavasses}.
e.zh: 外国官员由土耳其武装卫士护送。

e.en: The scholar translated a passage of {kavya}.
e.zh: 那位学者翻译了一段梵语宫廷诗。

e.en: Her lecture compared epic verse with {kavya}.
e.zh: 她的讲座比较了史诗诗体和梵语宫廷诗体。

e.en: Her notebook was covered in {kawaii} stickers.
e.zh: 她的笔记本贴满了日式可爱风贴纸。

e.en: The cafe uses a deliberately {kawaii} style.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆刻意采用萌系风格。

e.en: They brewed tea from {kawakawa} leaves.
e.zh: 他们用卡瓦卡瓦叶泡茶。

e.en: The {kawakawa} plant grows well in damp shade.
e.zh: 卡瓦卡瓦灌木在潮湿阴凉处长得很好。

e.en: He spread {kaya} on warm toast.
e.zh: 他把咖椰酱抹在热吐司上。

e.en: The bakery sells jars of homemade {kaya}.
e.zh: 这家面包店出售自制椰蛋甜酱罐头。

e.en: Farmers used {kasugamycin} to control bacterial disease in the crop.
e.zh: 农民使用春日霉素来防治作物的细菌性病害。

e.en: The lab tested whether {kasugamycin} affected protein synthesis.
e.zh: 实验室检测了春日霉素是否会影响蛋白质合成。

e.en: A cold {katabatic} wind swept down from the glacier.
e.zh: 一股寒冷的下坡风从冰川上吹下来。

e.en: Pilots were warned about strong {katabatic} gusts near the valley.
e.zh: 飞行员被提醒注意山谷附近强烈的下降阵风。

e.en: Stress can push the body into a {katabolic} state.
e.zh: 压力可能使身体进入分解代谢状态。

e.en: The drug slowed several {katabolic} reactions in the cells.
e.zh: 这种药减缓了细胞中的几种分解代谢反应。

e.en: Exercise increases fat {katabolism} during recovery.
e.zh: 运动会在恢复期间增加脂肪分解代谢。

e.en: The textbook explains {katabolism} before discussing energy storage.
e.zh: 这本教材先解释分解代谢，再讨论能量储存。

e.en: The researchers measured each {katabolite} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血样中的每种分解代谢产物。

e.en: A toxic {katabolite} may build up when the enzyme fails.
e.zh: 当这种酶失效时，有毒的分解代谢产物可能会积聚。

katachromasis.t: 皮肤变色；色素沉着异常

e.en: The physician noted mild {katachromasis} around the old scar.
e.zh: 医生注意到旧疤周围有轻微的皮肤变色。

e.en: Rare cases of {katachromasis} were described in the medical report.
e.zh: 医学报告中描述了少见的皮肤色素异常病例。

katagenesis.t: 成岩后期变化；降解演化

e.en: Oil forms as organic matter undergoes {katagenesis} underground.
e.zh: 有机质在地下经历降解演化时会形成石油。

e.en: The geologist linked the rock's chemistry to deep {katagenesis}.
e.zh: 地质学家把岩石的化学特征与深部成岩后期变化联系起来。

e.en: Foreign words in Japanese are often written in {katakana}.
e.zh: 日语中的外来词常用片假名书写。

e.en: She learned {katakana} after mastering hiragana.
e.zh: 她掌握平假名后又学习了片假名。

e.en: The diagram labels the {katakinetomere} during chromosome movement.
e.zh: 这张图标出了染色体移动时的后动粒结构。

e.en: Few students had heard of a {katakinetomere} before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座前很少有学生听说过后动粒。

e.en: The paper describes a {katakinetomeric} region on the chromosome.
e.zh: 论文描述了染色体上的一个后动粒相关区域。

e.en: They observed {katakinetomeric} changes under the microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下观察到后动粒相关的变化。

e.en: The culture produced {katalase} when exposed to oxygen.
e.zh: 培养物接触氧气时产生了过氧化氢酶。

e.en: Older texts sometimes spell catalase as {katalase}.
e.zh: 较旧的文献有时把 catalase 拼作 katalase。

e.en: The database listed {katalaze} as an old spelling of catalase.
e.zh: 数据库把 katalaze 列为 catalase 的旧式拼法。

e.en: A search for {katalaze} redirected her to catalase.
e.zh: 她搜索 katalaze 时被重定向到过氧化氢酶。

e.en: The old chemistry book used {katalysis} instead of catalysis.
e.zh: 那本旧化学书用 katalysis 来表示催化作用。

e.en: Modern journals rarely accept the spelling {katalysis}.
e.zh: 现代期刊很少接受 katalysis 这种拼写。

e.en: The nineteenth-century article called the substance a {katalyst}.
e.zh: 那篇十九世纪文章把这种物质称为 katalyst。

e.en: Students may see {katalyst} in historical chemistry texts.
e.zh: 学生可能会在化学史文献中看到 katalyst 这个拼法。

e.en: Some older writers used {katalyze} where we write catalyze today.
e.zh: 一些早期作者用 katalyze 表示今天的 catalyze。

e.en: The enzyme can {katalyze} the reaction in this archaic spelling.
e.zh: 按这种旧拼法，这种酶可以催化该反应。

e.en: The mineral showed signs of {katamorphism} after burial.
e.zh: 这种矿物在埋藏后显示出降级变质的迹象。

e.en: Geologists debated whether {katamorphism} had altered the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家争论退变作用是否改变了这块岩石。

e.en: The museum displayed a polished {katana} from the Edo period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把江户时代的抛光武士刀。

e.en: In the film, the warrior draws his {katana} silently.
e.zh: 电影中，武士无声地拔出他的日本刀。

e.en: The disease entered a {kataphase} after the fever broke.
e.zh: 退烧后，病情进入了衰退期。

e.en: The theory describes culture moving through a {kataphase}.
e.zh: 该理论描述文化进入一个下降阶段。

e.en: The herb was said to have a {katastaltic} effect.
e.zh: 据说这种草药有镇静抑制作用。

e.en: Older medical writers used {katastaltic} for calming remedies.
e.zh: 早期医学作者用 katastaltic 指镇静类疗法。

katathermal.t: 低温热液的；冷却测热的

e.en: The vein formed under {katathermal} conditions deep underground.
e.zh: 这条矿脉是在地下深处的低温热液条件下形成的。

e.en: They recorded {katathermal} readings to estimate air movement.
e.zh: 他们记录冷却测热读数来估算空气流动。

katathermometer.t: 冷却测温计；卡他温度计

e.en: The technician used a {katathermometer} to assess ventilation.
e.zh: 技术员使用冷却测温计来评估通风情况。

e.en: A {katathermometer} measures cooling power rather than simple temperature.
e.zh: 卡他温度计测量的是冷却能力，而不只是温度。

e.en: The boxer was {kayoed} in the second round.
e.zh: 那名拳击手在第二回合被击倒。

e.en: The sudden news seemed to {kayo} the whole team.
e.zh: 这个突如其来的消息似乎让整个团队都懵了。

e.en: He was {kayoed} by a single punch.
e.zh: 他被一拳打倒昏了过去。

e.en: The flu {kayoed} her for a week.
e.zh: 流感让她整整一周都撑不起来。

e.en: The champion kept {kayoing} opponents early.
e.zh: 这位冠军总是很早就把对手击倒。

e.en: That workload is {kayoing} the new staff.
e.zh: 那样的工作量正把新员工压垮。

e.en: The fighter {kayos} most challengers quickly.
